environment.detail: Exact instruction/source pins, clean detached worktree, zero open PRs at start, input/init/partition/parameter match, deterministic/TF32 off, resource floors; no source edits or installs.

forward_backward.detail: P3 selected policy passed T512 seed42, T512 seed43 and T2048 seed42: forward gates, same-input FP32 gates, equal named gradient inventory, finite global rel <=0.05 and all per-tensor gradient gates.

handover.detail: Flat sanitized package with exact reproduction, full screen, P3 qualification, six resource reports, analysis, source identity, invocation notes and execution log; validator result in PR body.

precision_screen.detail: P1 and P2 rejected on tensor/routing gates; P3 full FP32 passed natural-route gates and was selected in P1,P2,P3 order before any resource measurement; policy versus original BF16 deltas reported as precision-confounded context.

reproduction.detail: Original BF16 T512 seed42 scan identity/losses exact, chunk64 published loss delta 0.0, per-key routing counts exact, tensor metrics within 1e-6; natural routes retained.

resources.detail: Six fresh-process P3/original-context cases passed: T512/T2048, scan/chunk64 selected policy plus original BF16 scan context; medians/min/max, peaks, baseline and finite forward/backward recorded; no optimizer step.

limitations: Synthetic T512/T2048 fixed-seed cases only; no actual data, training, optimizer update, checkpoint or convergence claim.
P3 is a full FP32 control, not a BF16 replacement; no default adoption even where faster.
P1/P2 failed natural-route tensor/routing gates; no fixed-route rescue was attempted.
Resource timings are descriptive, fresh-process, forward/loss/backward only; no throughput or sustained-training claim.
Cross-policy quality/cost comparison is ambiguous because precision policy changed.
